changelog: Fix: deleting a NIC must not wipe VLAN netplan (eth1.10 / eth1.20 stay)
Fix: SSL VPN uses DNS search domain when dns_domain is empty
Fix: wg-watchdog must not bounce unused WireGuard when IPSec is the live path
Fix: dns-watchdog must not restart dnsmasq when an external DNS probe fails
Fix: GeoIP must ACCEPT OpenVPN 1194 on WAN (SSH/GUI stay dropped; IKE/WG still peer-locked)
